name: Rose
source:
Time Suit: Silver Armor
Interests: Fencing
Likes: Cup of tea

A level-headed and slightly refined Time Tenshi who fights with her powerful sword. Her dazzling smile and gentle personality impress, but in the heat of battle she can become passionately aggressive, especially when she's protecting those she cares about.
